summary: Flock cameras alerted Willowick police to a stolen vehicle near the Willowick/Eastlake border at approximately 3:30 a.m. on April 11, 2023. An officer located and attempted to stop the vehicle, which crashed head-on into the police cruiser; the driver was apprehended at the scene.

camera_role: LPR hit alerted police to stolen vehicle location
summary: A Flock camera alert notified Hopkinsville police of a stolen red 2019 Mitsubishi Outlander in the area of North Main Street and the Bypass. Officers located the vehicle, confirmed it was stolen, and arrested the driver, 27-year-old Matthew Lynn of Madisonville, who was charged with felony receiving stolen property.

camera_role: LPR data tracked suspect vehicle across jurisdictions
summary: Flock camera data helped investigators track a vehicle associated with the January 2023 homicide of Aonesty Selby across multiple jurisdictions, leading to charges against Andarius McClelland. The system allowed law enforcement to follow the suspect vehicle from Newport News through Hampton and into Isle of Wight County.

camera_role: LPR system assisted in locating suspect
summary: US Marshal officials arrested a murder suspect in Butler County on May 11, 2023, with assistance from Rose Hill's Flock cameras.

camera_role: LPR system helped isolate suspect vehicle leading to arrest
summary: Flock license-plate-reading cameras assisted Wichita police in solving a homicide in the Planeview area, leading to the arrest of 24-year-old Angel Lara. This marked the 11th homicide the Flock system helped to solve in Wichita.

camera_role: LPR tracking located suspect vehicle across county lines
summary: A 24-year-old shooter opened fire at an Atlanta medical center, wounding six people and killing one. Flock Safety's license plate reader system helped police track the suspect's vehicle from Atlanta into Cobb County, leading to the suspect's apprehension.

camera_role: LPR identified stolen vehicle connected to break-ins
summary: A Flock camera on Bentley Road detected a stolen vehicle connected to multiple car break-ins in Marietta. Police pursued the vehicle, which crashed after a brief chase; three juvenile suspects were apprehended and three guns were recovered.

camera_role: LPR tracked suspect vehicle in burglary investigation
summary: Steven Sheangshang was tracked by West Chester's Flock license plate readers in connection with a series of car and garage robberies in the Beckett Ridge area. The tracking led to a traffic stop on I-75 near Georgetown, Kentucky, during which Deputy Caleb Conley was fatally shot.

camera_role: LPR identified stolen vehicle
summary: Beaver Dam police were alerted by the Flock Camera System to a stolen vehicle on Highway 151, initiating a pursuit that ended when the suspect vehicle crashed into a tree. The driver was arrested on suspicion of operating while intoxicated and drug-related offenses.

camera_role: LPR captured suspect vehicle license plate at crime-related location
summary: Madeline Pantoja was found dead near Midland, Texas on May 20, 2023, and her boyfriend Mario Chacon was arrested for her murder. A Flock camera recorded Chacon's vehicle license plate in the area at 3:22 a.m. on May 12, corroborating investigative evidence that helped establish his presence near the body disposal location.

camera_role: LPR alert detected sex offender's vehicle near school, triggered rapid police response
summary: On April 19, 2023, a Flock camera alerted Lake Forest police that a vehicle registered to a sex offender was near Lake Forest Academy. Officers conducted a stop and discovered the driver had entered school property in violation of his sex offender status, leading to his arrest and May 16 felony charge.

camera_role: LPR image identified Cadillac plate number at car wash
summary: U.S. marshals tracking escaped Alabama inmate Casey White and jail officer Vicky White used a Flock automatic license plate reader image from a car wash to obtain the Cadillac's plate number, which confirmed the suspects' vehicle and location at Motel 41 in Evansville, leading to their apprehension on May 9, 2023.

camera_role: Flock alert identified stolen vehicle entering city limits
summary: Camden Police responded to a Flock alert about a stolen vehicle and arrested Raymond Luke Edward Watkins on drug charges after seizing approximately 9.6 grams of methamphetamine. The Flock camera system enabled officers to locate and apprehend the suspect.

camera_role: LPR hit detected stolen vehicle
summary: A 2013 GMC Sierra 1500 truck was reported stolen from a motel. A Flock camera recorded the vehicle heading westbound on Bonham Street at 8:20 am, and the victim later recovered the truck in Honey Grove.

camera_role: LPR system located suspect vehicle fleeing to Oklahoma
summary: A 45-year-old man shot a pedestrian in Wichita on June 6, 2023, critically injuring him. Wichita police used Flock Safety's license plate reader to track the suspect's white Audi heading south toward Oklahoma, and the suspect was subsequently arrested by Norman police.

camera_role: LPR hit located stolen vehicles
summary: Sand Springs police used newly installed Flock Safety cameras to locate a stolen U-Haul and motorcycle on June 5, leading to two arrests, and recovered another stolen car on June 10 through Flock camera alerts at different locations around the city.

camera_role: LPR hit triggered Missing Persons-NCIC alert and located suspect vehicle
summary: Flock Safety cameras detected a vehicle matching a Missing Persons alert as it crossed into Warrick County, Indiana on June 11, 2023. The LPR hit led deputies to locate and stop the vehicle, rescuing four missing children ages 2-9 and arresting non-custodial parent Danielle Cleary who had fled Nebraska with them.

camera_role: LPR tracking located stolen vehicle in real-time
summary: A woman stole a car being cleaned at a Fairfield car wash on June 5, 2023. Police used Flock Safety license plate reading to track the vehicle and successfully stopped it, leading to the arrest of 39-year-old Davina Wilson.

camera_role: LPR alert identified suspect vehicle and license plate
summary: A 17-year-old was shot in the chest at Keeper of the Plains parking lot in Wichita early Friday morning. Police used the Flock Safety license plate reader system to identify a suspect vehicle and tag, which they are actively following up on.

camera_role: Flock alert detected stolen vehicle with California plates
outcome: arrests for false statements and vehicle theft
summary: A Flock camera alert notified Spokane County deputies of a possibly stolen rental vehicle in north Spokane early on June 26, 2023. Deputies located the vehicle at a Circle K and detained the occupants, leading to arrests of the driver and passenger for making false statements and vehicle theft.

camera_role: License check via Flock camera system located suspect vehicle
summary: Three men were arrested in connection with a check fraud investigation in Cape Girardeau, Missouri. Officers used the Flock camera system to conduct a license check that located the suspect vehicle, leading to the apprehension of all three suspects.

camera_role: LPR hit alert for stolen vehicle registration
summary: Hazleton police received a Flock Camera System notification indicating a hit for a stolen vehicle registration on a Silver Nissan Sentra. The stop led to a chase that ended when the driver crashed into four vehicles, and Amy Gancio was arrested and charged with fleeing and eluding, receiving stolen property, and drug offenses.

camera_role: LPR detected suspect vehicle, alert issued for lookout
summary: A man was shot in the arm during a carjacking attempt in Augusta, Georgia. A Flock camera identified the suspect vehicle, leading to an alert that assisted law enforcement in locating and arresting the suspect.

camera_role: LPR system helped identify suspect
summary: Troy University police arrested 22-year-old Tristin Dawson for 18 counts of burglary after he illegally entered fraternity houses on May 27, 2023. The Flock LPR camera system on campus was used to help identify the suspect.

camera_role: Flock notification located stolen vehicle
summary: Police received a Flock camera alert about a stolen vehicle near 73rd and Memorial. The suspects fled police, hit two vehicles, and caused a fatal crash near 68th and Memorial that killed one person. One suspect was arrested and charged with first-degree murder.

camera_role: LPR system located suspect vehicle
summary: Flock Safety cameras helped Indianapolis police locate murder suspect Chaznee Mockabee on June 26, 2023, who was wanted in connection with the December 2021 shooting death of D'Lon Edwards. The license plate readers tracked her vehicle movements and led to her arrest.

camera_role: LPR hit identified suspect vehicle at crime scene
summary: Flock Safety cameras helped Springfield Police capture Justin Bartels, one of two suspects in a shooting that killed an 18-year-old. Investigators traced a truck at the crime scene back to Bartels using the license plate reader system, leading to his arrest on second-degree murder charges.

camera_role: LPR identified suspect vehicle license plates
outcome: four suspects arrested and held by U.S. Marshals
summary: Flock Safety cameras in Taylorville helped identify suspect vehicles involved in break-ins at six gun shops across multiple Illinois cities. The license plate data was used to locate four Peoria residents who now face federal charges for conspiracy to steal firearms from licensed dealers.

camera_role: LPR notification of stolen vehicle detected in area
outcome: three suspects arrested, firearms and cocaine recovered
summary: West Allis police received a Flock Safety camera notification of a stolen vehicle near 60th and National on August 25, 2023. Officers located and stopped the vehicle, resulting in three arrests and the recovery of three firearms, crack cocaine, and digital scales.

camera_role: LPR alert identified stolen vehicle location
summary: West Allis police received a Flock Safety camera alert about a stolen SUV near 60th and National. Officers located the vehicle, initiated a traffic stop that led to a high-speed chase, and arrested three teenage suspects after they abandoned the burning vehicle.

camera_role: Real-time ALPR alert located stolen vehicle
summary: A vehicle stolen in March 2022 was located in El Cajon on August 12, 2023 with the help of Flock Safety ALPR cameras. The driver, Celestina Thomas, was arrested for possession of a stolen vehicle and an outstanding misdemeanor warrant.

camera_role: LPR hit located suspect vehicle during investigation
summary: Two teenagers attempted to carjack a vehicle in Waukesha but abandoned the attempt when the owner retained the key fob. They fled to a silver Nissan getaway car, which was then identified through a Flock Safety camera hit. The ensuing police chase and crash resulted in four felony arrests of teenage carjacking suspects.

camera_role: LPR system identified fleeing vehicle
summary: A hit-and-run crash on Buwalda Lane left a woman with serious head trauma. Yakima police used the Flock camera system to identify the fleeing vehicle and located it approximately 90 minutes after the incident.

camera_role: LPR detection of stolen vehicle triggered traffic stop
summary: A Flock camera detected a stolen vehicle on Candler Road in Hall County on August 22, 2023. The detection led to a traffic stop in which the driver fled, crashed into a pickup truck, and was eventually apprehended by K9 team after abandoning the vehicle on railroad tracks.

camera_role: LPR identified suspect vehicle
summary: A 29-year-old man was arrested after shooting two people in Yakima on August 4, 2023. Flock security cameras in the city identified the suspect's vehicle, enabling police to locate and apprehend him.

camera_role: LPR assisted in suspect apprehension
summary: Flock Safety cameras assisted police in locating and apprehending suspects in a kidnapping case in Broken Arrow, Oklahoma.

camera_role: Flock footage reviewed to identify shooting suspects
summary: A 19-year-old man was shot in the leg during an exchange of gunfire at Milledgeville Manor Apartments on August 12, 2023. Detectives reviewed Flock camera footage in the area along with security videos and vehicle evidence to identify the offenders responsible for the shooting.

camera_role: LPR alert identified stolen vehicle location
outcome: traffic stop initiated, officer injured in resulting crash
summary: A Flock camera alert notified Officer Ruhlen of a stolen 2020 Ford Explorer on Main Street in Wichita. The officer located and initiated a traffic stop on the vehicle, but was struck by another vehicle at an intersection, resulting in injuries to the officer.

camera_role: LPR alert notified officer of stolen vehicle location
outcome: stolen vehicle located; officer and suspect injured in resulting crash
summary: Officer Christopher Ruhlen received a Flock camera alert about a stolen vehicle on Main Street in Wichita and attempted a traffic stop. The stolen vehicle struck the officer's SUV at the Kellogg Drive intersection, injuring both drivers.

camera_role: LPR alert located stolen vehicle
outcome: arrest, felony receiving stolen property and DUI charges filed
summary: A Clarksville man was arrested after Hopkinsville police received a Flock camera alert indicating a stolen vehicle was in the area of Riverfront Drive and West Second Street. Officers located the vehicle on South Kentucky Avenue and arrested the driver.

camera_role: LPR alert identified stolen vehicle
summary: Spokane County Sheriff's deputies were alerted by a FLOCK camera system to a stolen 1992 Chevrolet S-10 Pickup on July 29, 2023. The alert led deputies to locate and arrest a 22-year-old man, a 12-time convicted felon, who was found in possession of the stolen vehicle and an unlawful firearm.

camera_role: LPR/FLOCK system identified suspect vehicle
summary: A male juvenile suspect was arrested in connection with a drive-by shooting on East Dixie Avenue in Elizabethtown that left the victim with non-life-threatening injuries. The Elizabethtown Police Department used their FLOCK camera system to identify the suspect after initial investigative leads were unavailable.

camera_role: LPR system helped locate suspect
summary: Flock cameras in Catoosa, Oklahoma assisted in locating a suspect connected to an Illinois mass murder investigation.

camera_role: LPR hit located stolen vehicle
summary: Flock camera detected a stolen U-Haul truck near Pittman and Suisun Valley Road in Fairfield, leading to a police pursuit. Two women were arrested after abandoning the vehicle and fleeing on foot.

camera_role: LPR tracking located suspect vehicle path and enabled law enforcement to narrow search area
summary: A 24-year-old man carjacked a Toyota RAV4 at a Kroger in Baldwin County, Georgia on September 16, 2023. Flock cameras tracked the vehicle's movement through multiple streets, allowing deputies to locate and arrest the suspect less than an hour after the crime.

camera_role: Flock camera captured stolen vehicle location near Lopes Road and I-80
summary: Fairfield police apprehended one adult and three youths after a stolen Oakland vehicle was tracked via a Flock camera near Lopes Road and I-80 on I-80. The suspects were found in possession of key fobs, a key programmer, and a loaded handgun.

camera_role: LPR hit located stolen vehicles
summary: Flock cameras helped Lexington Police locate multiple stolen vehicles and apprehend suspects, including one incident on Winburn Drive where a stolen car was spotted and the driver arrested after a chase, and another on Richmond Road where two men were taken into custody. The technology has recovered over $2.8 million in stolen vehicles since installation.

camera_role: LPR identified and tracked stolen vehicles
summary: Black Diamond police deployed Flock Safety automatic license plate readers on well-traveled roads and within 60 days recovered four stolen vehicles and assisted an outside agency's homicide investigation. The cameras identified 28 stolen vehicles traveling through the city during the trial period.

camera_role: LPR alerts detected stolen vehicles, plates, and fugitives in real-time
outcome: 1 stolen vehicle recovered, 3 stolen plates recovered, 2 arrest warrants served, 6 drug charges filed, 1 firearm seized, 1 missing juvenile found
summary: Glasgow Police deployed six Flock Safety cameras on September 11, 2023, which have recorded over 600,000 license plates. The system has assisted in multiple investigations including recovering stolen vehicles, identifying drug trafficking suspects, seizing firearms, and locating a missing juvenile.

camera_role: Flock Safety camera assisted in locating suspect vehicle
summary: A bicyclist was struck by a pickup truck in a hit-and-run incident in East Tulsa. Flock Safety cameras, along with witness descriptions, helped police locate the suspect vehicle and arrest Kijuan Washington.

camera_role: assisted in locating missing person
summary: A missing Dougherty County man was found with the assistance of Flock Safety cameras.

camera_role: LPR system located suspect vehicle
summary: David Hernandez was apprehended after attempting multiple carjackings and stealing a vehicle from a grocery store parking lot in Baytown. Flock Safety Technology helped police locate the stolen 2020 Ford Fusion, leading to a pursuit and the suspect's eventual capture.

camera_role: Monitored stolen vehicle location as it moved through city
outcome: Vehicle located and recovered; suspect fled on foot, apprehension pending
summary: A Chevy Silverado was stolen from Tewksbury on October 7, 2023. Flock Safety cameras in Lowell tracked the vehicle's movement through the city as police pursued it, leading to the truck's location in Pawtucketville where it crashed; the suspect fled on foot and remained at large.

camera_role: Flock camera established timeline and identified suspect vehicle
summary: A dog was dumped in a recycling bin in Rio Vista on September 18, 2023, and died at a shelter. Flock Safety cameras were used to determine when the dumping occurred and identify the suspect's vehicle, leading to the arrest of a Fairfield man for felony animal cruelty.

camera_role: Flock footage identified getaway vehicle and led to suspect's home
outcome: suspect arrested, stolen money and handgun recovered
summary: An armed robbery at a Shell gas station on Highway 81 was solved when Flock camera footage identified the getaway vehicle and led deputies to the suspect's home in Gwinnett County. The suspect was arrested during a traffic stop within 90 minutes, and stolen money and a handgun were recovered.

camera_role: LPR alert located stolen vehicle in area
summary: A Flock camera system alerted Hanford police to a stolen Chevrolet in the area of 10th Avenue and Lacey Boulevard. Officers quickly located the vehicle at a gas station and arrested the driver, who was found in possession of methamphetamine and a shaved key matching the vehicle.

camera_role: LPR identified getaway vehicle
outcome: two suspects arrested on first-degree murder charges
summary: Two teens were fatally shot at a house party in El Cajon on October 28, 2023. Flock Safety license plate readers helped detectives identify the getaway vehicle, leading to the arrest of suspects Bruce Luu and Dan Nalab on first-degree murder charges.

camera_role: Flock Safety system assisted multi-agency investigation leading to arrest
summary: A suspect in an August ATM break-in at Heritage Federal Credit Union was arrested following an investigation involving the Flock Safety system and multiple agencies across several states. The Flock system assisted law enforcement in identifying and apprehending 21-year-old Dmyree Martin.

camera_role: LPR data led to recovery of missing juvenile
summary: Licking Heights School District installed 11 Flock cameras across its campuses with a $30,000 Ohio School Safety grant. Pataskala Deputy Chief of Police Michael Boals stated that the Flock system has been beneficial in investigations, including recovering a runaway missing juvenile based on Flock information.

camera_role: LPR hit located suspect vehicle
summary: Flock Safety cameras helped officers locate a vehicle involved in an assault-turned-kidnapping in Kalamazoo. Officers used the system to stop the vehicle and arrest the suspect, recovering the child unharmed in under 20 minutes.

camera_role: LPR hit located suspect vehicle
summary: Watsonville Police used their Flock Safety license plate-reading cameras to identify a Honda Accord belonging to Juan Fernando Marquez, a man wanted for attempted murder in connection with a stabbing. The camera alert led officers to stop Marquez, who was subsequently arrested after allegedly stabbing a police dog during the encounter.
